question: बीकानेर, राजस्थान में एक घायल सामुदायिक कुत्ते को इलाज के लिए कहाँ ले जा सकता हूँ? किसी अस्पताल का नाम और पता या प्रकाशित फोन नंबर दीजिए।
expected: Answer in Hindi; preserve Bikaner Rajasthan; safe immediate guidance and a source-supported dog-treatment provider with address or published phone.
answer:
कुत्ते को यथासंभव शांत रखें और सड़क/वाहनों से दूर रखें। अगर सुरक्षित हो तो उसे किसी बॉक्स, चादर या वाहन में कम-से-कम हिलाते हुए ले जाएँ; जबरन खाना या पानी न दें।

**राजकीय पशु चिकित्सालय, नत्थूसर गेट**  
नत्थूसर गेट, बीकानेर, राजस्थान **334001**। यह राजस्थान सरकार की सूची में बीकानेर का पशु चिकित्सालय दर्ज है। ([lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in](https://www.lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/environment/RPCB/BarcodeofHCF/Bar%20code%20final.pdf?utm_source=openai))

history.content: An injured community kitten is near Gajuwaka, Visakhapatnam. Where can I take her for treatment? Please give a facility name and its address or published phone.

Keep the kitten warm, quiet and away from traffic; handle as little as possible and carry her in a ventilated box/carrier lined with a towel if you can do so safely.

**Starbreeds Pet Clinic — Gajuwaka**  
Kanithi Road, near SFS School, Gonthinavanipalem, Gajuwaka, Visakhapatnam.  
**Phone:** +91 90396 99039  
The clinic publishes veterinary consultations, diagnostics and surgery, and lists hours as 9 AM–10 PM daily—please call while travelling to confirm they can receive an injured community kitten. ([starbreeds.in](https://www.starbreeds.in/?utm_source=openai))
https://www.starbreeds.in/?utm_source=openai

The Bai Sakarbai Dinshaw Petit Hospital for Animals  
Dr. S. S. Rao Road, Parel, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400012
Does that hospital send an ambulance to collect street animals? Give a published ambulance contact only if a source explicitly supports pickup.

However, I could not verify a **published ambulance-specific pickup number**, so I won’t give a general hospital number as though it were an ambulance dispatch line. Where can I take an injured street dog in Aurangabad? I can arrange transport.

Keep the dog quiet and away from traffic while you arrange transport. If there is active bleeding, hold gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth if it is safe to approach; do not force food or water.

**Government Veterinary Hospital / Veterinary Polyclinic, Khadkeshwar**  
Veterinary Hospital Campus, Khadkeshwar, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (formerly Aurangabad), Maharashtra 431001. The Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department lists the district veterinary facility in the Khadkeshwar veterinary-hospital premises. ([dahd.maharashtra.gov.in](https://dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/directory/?utm_source=openai))

For confirmation before leaving, the official district Animal Husbandry office number is **0240-2991442**; it is an administrative contact, so ask whether the veterinary hospital is receiving an injured street dog at that time. **Government Veterinary Hospital / District Veterinary Polyclinic**  
Khadkeshwar, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra **431001**  
**Published phone:** **75887 04082**  

This is the government veterinary hospital cited in a Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Municipal Corporation vaccination announcement; the Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department also places the district veterinary-polyclinic premises at Khadkeshwar. Please call first to confirm it can receive the injured dog now. A limping community dog is near Salt Lake, Kolkata. Find a clinic that treats dogs, with its address or published phone. Do not limit the search to NGOs.

Keep the dog calm and away from traffic while arranging transport. A limp can be painful even when there is no visible wound, so avoid making the dog walk farther than necessary.

**Animal Pride Pet Clinic**  
BE-10, Sector I, Salt Lake, Kolkata – 700064  
**Published phone:** **74397 67977** / **74397 67978**  

The clinic publishes veterinary services and an emergency contact at these numbers. Call first and explain that it is a limping community dog, to confirm the doctor can see the dog when you arrive. ([animalpride.in](https://animalpride.in/pet-clinic?utm_source=openai))
